title: Windows build crashes on RX 7900 XT (Vulkan device was lost)
body:
### Tested versions

- Occured with v4.4.1.stable.mono and v4.5.stable.mono
- Untested in other versions

### System information

Godot v4.4.1.stable.mono - Windows 11 (build 26100) - 2 monitors - Vulkan (Forward+) - AMD Radeon RX 7900 XT (32.0.12019.1028) - AMD Ryzen 9 7900X 12-Core Processor (24 CPUs), ~4.7GHz

### Issue description

My game crashes on a testers PC after running for 5-10 minutes.
The game uses Post-Processing like Volumetric Fog, Glow and SSAO as well as many emissive materials.
I can't provide the project publicly, but could do so in private. And the demo is live on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3634980/The_Greenening_Demo/
